subtitle.en: One arm holds. The other assembles.
subtitle.zh: 一台稳定工件，另一台完成装配。

description.en: One robot grips and steadies a housing while its partner picks an insert and places it in the pocket. A shared work-area lease holds the support arm still during insertion. Swap roles or replace either arm without changing the app.
description.zh: 一台机器人夹住并稳定壳体，另一台取来嵌件放入定位槽。共享工作区域控制在插入过程中让支撑臂保持稳定。可以交换角色或替换机械臂，无需改变应用。

label.zh: 控制两台机械臂与夹爪

label.en: Reserve the shared assembly work area

origin.en: Physical locating and placement in one MuJoCo world; a simulated shared-area lease, without a press-fit or hardware safety claim.
origin.zh: 在一个 MuJoCo 世界中进行物理定位与放置；模拟共享区域控制，不包含压装模型或硬件安全认证。

description.en: Arm A holds the housing; Arm B places the insert, then both withdraw.
description.zh: A 臂保持壳体，B 臂放入嵌件，然后两臂退出。

description.en: Arm B holds the housing while Arm A performs the insertion.
description.zh: B 臂保持壳体，由 A 臂完成嵌件放置。
